typeProperties.script:
section Section1;
shared p_schools_s = let AdfDoc = AzureStorage.DataLakeContents("https://growecdstorage.dfs.core.windows.net/giraffe/parque/p_schools_s.parquet"), Parquet = Parquet.Document(AzureStorage.DataLakeContents("https://growecdstorage.dfs.core.windows.net/giraffe/parque/p_schools_s.parquet")) in Parquet;
shared UserQuery = let
  Source = p_schools_s,

CleanText = (txt as nullable text) =>  
    if txt = null then null else  
    Text.Remove(  
        txt,  
        List.Transform({0..31}, each Character.FromNumber(_))  
    ),  
  #"Cleaned address" = Table.TransformColumns(  
    Source,  
    {{"address", CleanText, type text}}  
  ),    
  #"Removed other columns" = Table.SelectColumns(#"Cleaned address", {"break_even_fee", "owner_id", "agreement_type", "segment", "monthly_salaries", "school_status", "updated_at", "created_at", "contract_start_date", "ecd_code", "school_commencement_date", "address", "number_of_classrooms", "name", "city_id", "region_id", "school_id", "id", "capacity"}),
  #"Changed column type 1" = Table.TransformColumnTypes(#"Removed other columns", {{"number_of_classrooms", Int64.Type}}),
  #"Removed columns" = Table.RemoveColumns(#"Changed column type 1", {"created_at"}),
  Replace_Status_Active = Table.ReplaceValue(#"Removed columns", "Active", "301220000", Replacer.ReplaceText, {"school_status"}),
  Replace_Status_NotActive = Table.ReplaceValue(Replace_Status_Active, "Not 301220000", "301220000", Replacer.ReplaceText, {"school_status"}),
  Replace_Status_Duplicated = Table.ReplaceValue(Replace_Status_NotActive, "{""id"":5,""name"":""Duplicated or created in error"",""c", "301220004", Replacer.ReplaceValue, {"school_status"}),
  Replace_Status_ExitedYr1 = Table.ReplaceValue(Replace_Status_Duplicated, "{""id"":2,""name"":""Exited During Year 1"",""created_at""", "301220001", Replacer.ReplaceValue, {"school_status"}),
  Replace_BreakEvenFee = Table.ReplaceValue(Replace_Status_ExitedYr1, null, 0, Replacer.ReplaceValue, {"break_even_fee"}),
  Replace_NumClassrooms = Table.ReplaceValue(Replace_BreakEvenFee, null, 0, Replacer.ReplaceValue, {"number_of_classrooms"}),
  Replace_AgreementType_Empty = Table.ReplaceValue(Replace_NumClassrooms, null, "None", Replacer.ReplaceValue, {"agreement_type"}),
  #"Replaced value" = Table.ReplaceValue(Replace_AgreementType_Empty, "", "None", Replacer.ReplaceValue, {"agreement_type"}),
  Add_CountryId = Table.AddColumn(#"Replaced value", "tcbgrow_country", each 710),
  #"Renamed columns" = Table.RenameColumns(Add_CountryId, {{"address", "tcbgrow_address"}, {"agreement_type", "tcbgrow_paymenttype"}, {"break_even_fee", "tcbgrow_breakeven"}, {"capacity", "tcbgrow_capacity"}, {"city_id", "cog_city"}, {"region_id", "cog_region"}, {"contract_start_date", "tcbgrow_contractdate"}, {"ecd_code", "tcbgrow_ecdcode"}, {"id", "tcbgrow_appid"}, {"monthly_salaries", "tcbgrow_monthlysalaries"}, {"name", "tcbgrow_name"}, {"number_of_classrooms", "tcbgrow_numberofclassrooms"}, {"owner_id", "tcbgrow_ecdowner"}, {"school_commencement_date", "tcbgrow_commencementdate"}, {"school_id", "tcbgrow_growid"}, {"school_status", "tcbgrow_schoolstatus"}, {"segment", "tcbgrow_schoolsegment"}}),
  #"Duplicated column" = Table.DuplicateColumn(#"Renamed columns", "tcbgrow_contractdate", "tcbgrow_appaccountcreationdate"),
  #"Duplicated column 1" = Table.DuplicateColumn(#"Duplicated column", "tcbgrow_commencementdate", "tcbgrow_centrestartdate"),
  #"Changed column type" = Table.TransformColumnTypes(#"Duplicated column 1", {{"tcbgrow_monthlysalaries", type number}, {"tcbgrow_schoolstatus", Int64.Type}}),
  #"Replaced value 1" = Table.ReplaceValue(#"Changed column type", "Programme", "2", Replacer.ReplaceText, {"tcbgrow_schoolsegment"}),
  #"Replaced value 2" = Table.ReplaceValue(#"Replaced value 1", "Platform", "1", Replacer.ReplaceText, {"tcbgrow_schoolsegment"}),
  #"Replaced value 3" = Table.ReplaceValue(#"Replaced value 2", "Non-2", "5", Replacer.ReplaceText, {"tcbgrow_schoolsegment"}),
  #"Replaced value 4" = Table.ReplaceValue(#"Replaced value 3", null, "", Replacer.ReplaceValue, {"tcbgrow_schoolsegment"}),
  #"Changed column type 2" = Table.TransformColumnTypes(#"Replaced value 4", {{"tcbgrow_schoolsegment", Int64.Type}})  

in
  #"Changed column type 2";
